crossRefs.note: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and…
Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.
he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from…
has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor; shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all…
who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has…
All the relatives of the poor shun him: how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they…
He must restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity!”

translations.web: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
translations.bsb: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury lays it up for one who is kind to the poor.
translations.kjv: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
translations.asv: He that augmenteth his substance by interest and increase, Gathereth it for him that hath pity on the poor.
